summary: See how ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini cite brands, prompts, and sources.

toolsPreview.name: parse_search
toolsPreview.description: Find brands, organic AI prompts, citation sources, and market niches for marketer research. Use this first when the user names a brand, category, source, or AI visibility question.

toolsPreview.name: parse_get_brand
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a concise public marketing brief for one brand, including Parse score, strengths, weak spots, top prompts, citation sources, related brands, and next research questions.

toolsPreview.name: parse_get_prompt
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one public organic prompt by slug when the user wants to inspect the exact AI-search question behind a result.

toolsPreview.name: parse_get_stats
toolsPreview.description: Explain the public Parse index scale and freshness: tracked brands, organic prompts, and citation observations.

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Compatibility alias for parse_search. Use for clients that expect a generic search tool.

toolsPreview.name: fetch
toolsPreview.description: Compatibility alias that resolves fetch IDs like brand:stripe or prompt:best-crm into JSON-text results with human-readable text.
